summary: Iteration 43 - Complete testing of Room Finish Schedule tile extraction feature. All backend API tests (8/8) and frontend UI tests passed. The new tile crop modal allows users to extract a single tile from multi-tile source images, then use that extracted tile to render patterns (Herringbone, Basket Weave, etc.) on wall zones.
critical_code_review_comments: TileCropModal component correctly implements canvas-based crop selection with mouse drag
USE THIS TILE button properly disabled until valid crop rectangle (>10px) is drawn
Existing crop is reused when placing same tile on another zone (no modal shown)
CROP TILE button allows re-cropping an existing placed tile
Pattern picker shows all 8 patterns: STACKED HORIZONTAL, STACKED VERTICAL, OFFSET, 1/3 OFFSET, HERRINGBONE, BASKET WEAVE, STEPLADDER, DIAGONAL
tile_crop field correctly persisted in backend MaterialEntry model
drawTilePattern function uses extracted tile crop coordinates for pattern rendering
Proxy image endpoint (/api/proxy-image) working for CORS bypass
seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo project with 4 tile items
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 43 verified the complete tile extraction workflow: 1) Select tile from palette (shows green ring + SELECTED message), 2) Click wall zone to open EXTRACT SINGLE TILE crop modal, 3) Draw rectangle to select one tile from source image, 4) USE THIS TILE button becomes active, 5) Tile placed on zone with crop data saved, 6) CROP TILE and PATTERN buttons appear on hover, 7) Pattern picker shows 8 patterns, 8) Selecting pattern renders extracted tile in that pattern with grout lines. Existing crop is reused when placing same tile on another zone.
